title: D&D 5.5e SRD Languages
description: Top-level array of languages. Entities rather than strings so a feature granting 'one language of your choice' can offer every loaded language, including ones a later pack adds.

rarity.description: Which table the language sits on. Character creation offers standard languages; rare ones come from features.

roll.description: The 1d12 result that picks this language on the Standard Languages table. Omitted for Common, which every character knows, and for rare languages.

dialects.description: Dialects whose speakers can all understand each other, as Primordial's Aquan, Auran, Ignan, and Terran.
